data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: grep for legacy config keys returns ONLY intentional refs (shim in read-config.sh, migrator, docs) — no unintended callers remain
- DD4: All tests pass after cleanup

## Implementation

Replace all direct grep-based config reads for legacy keys with calls to read-config.sh. These are the three stray scripts identified in Task 1's RED test.

### Files to Modify

**plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh** (lines 14-15):
```bash
# BEFORE (stray direct reads):
_enforcement=$(grep '^enforcement\.strategy=' "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- || echo "")
_merge=$(grep '^merge\.strategy=' "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- || echo "")

# AFTER (use read-config.sh shim):
_PLUGIN_SCRIPTS="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_enforcement=$(bash "$_PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || echo "")
_merge=$(bash "$_PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/read-config.sh" merge.strategy 2>/dev/null || echo "")
# Note: after epic completion, merge.strategy → dso.workflow; adjust based on what S1-S4 have done
```

IMPORTANT: Check what key names S1-S5 have migrated to. The read-config.sh shim (after S1) should translate legacy keys through to the new dso.workflow composite value. Use whatever key names read-config.sh exposes for the enforcement and merge mode values. Check plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh for the canonical key names before implementing.

**plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh** (around line 57):
```bash
# BEFORE:
_strategy="$(grep -m1 '^enforcement\.strategy=' "$_config_file" | cut -d= -f2-)"

# AFTER (call read-config.sh via absolute path — same pattern as other hooks):
_rc_script="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/../../scripts/read-config.sh"
_strategy="$(bash "$_rc_script" enforcement.strategy 2>/dev/null || true)"
# Or use the new dso.workflow key if S1-S4 have aliased it
```

**plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh** (around line 41):
```bash
# BEFORE:
_read="$(grep '^merge\.strategy=' "$_config_file" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)"

# AFTER:
_read="$(bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-config.sh" merge.strategy 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)"
```

**plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/github-bootstrap.sh** (line ~93, if it has an active read):
Check this file; if it has a direct grep read for merge.strategy, replace with read-config.sh call.

### Existing Tests to Update (UPDATE task)

Before modifying the scripts, update the tests that currently assert on the old direct-grep behavior:

1. **tests/hooks/lib/test-enforcement-gate-lib.sh** — if it tests enforcement.strategy reads directly via config file content (fixtures), update fixtures and assertions to match new read-config.sh call path. The DSO_CONFIG_PATH override pattern in enforcement-gate.sh tests should continue to work since read-config.sh also honors DSO_CONFIG_PATH.

2. **tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-config-driven.sh** — update to verify merge-to-main.sh reads config via read-config.sh rather than direct grep. Verify behavior under missing-config and wrong-value conditions still works.

Run these tests FIRST (they should PASS currently), then modify the source files, verify the tests still PASS (behavior unchanged — just the config-reading mechanism differs).

### Verification After Change

The Task 1 fitness function test should now PASS (GREEN) since mode-detect.sh, enforcement-gate.sh, and merge-to-main.sh no longer have direct grep reads for legacy keys.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] mode-detect.sh no longer contains direct grep reads for enforcement\.strategy or merge\.strategy
  Verify: { grep -F 'enforcement\.strategy=' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#'; test $? -ne 0; } 2>/dev/null; true
- [ ] enforcement-gate.sh no longer contains direct grep -m1 read for enforcement\.strategy
  Verify: { grep -F "grep -m1 '^enforcement\\.strategy=" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh; test $? -ne 0; } 2>/dev/null; true
- [ ] merge-to-main.sh no longer contains direct grep read for merge\.strategy
  Verify: { grep -F "grep '^merge\\.strategy=" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh; test $? -ne 0; } 2>/dev/null; true
- [ ] Task 1 fitness function test now PASSES (GREEN) for config key function
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh 2>&1 | grep 'test_no_legacy_config_keys_outside_allowlist' | grep -qv 'FAIL:'
- [ ] Existing config-reading behavior still works: mode-detect.sh returns local or ci-pr based on config
  Verify: DSO_CONFIG_PATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/dso-config.conf bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh
- [ ] Existing enforcement-gate tests still pass
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/lib/test-enforcement-gate-lib.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] Existing merge-to-main config-driven tests still pass
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-config-driven.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0'
data.title: UPDATE: Replace direct config-key grep reads with read-config.sh calls in mode-detect.sh, enforcement-gate.sh, merge-to-main.sh
